thread:
Miguel: Quick sync — CloudCo asked for a 1-click deploy pathway for Redwood Private on their marketplace. They want a Terraform module + example app + CI tests. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya: +1. They care about licensing (we need to surface EULA link), AMI/region mapping, and KMS key options. Also need an "upgrade" path for private customers.

Sana: We should split into two modules: `cloudco-marketplace-shim` for packaging (marketplace metadata, listing artifacts) and `redwood-private-installer` for infra (VPC, subnets, autoscaling GPU pool, KMS). Keeps package small.

Tom: Agree on separation. Also add an examples/ directory with a minimal webapp that calls the hosted API (or local endpoint) so partner can demo in their UI.

Ben: For infra module: variables we should include at minimum: region, instance_type_map, ami_map, kms_key_arn, vpc_id (optional), subnet_ids, ssh_key_name, enable_private_endpoint (bool). We'll add defaults where it makes sense.

Priya: CloudCo requires arm64 support (Graviton) and x86. Need matrix tests in CI that run across both. Also add a `compatibility.md` that lists recommended instance families.

Miguel: Timeline? They want a beta pack in 3 weeks to present to their marketplace team. Can we ship an MVP in 3 weeks? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Tom: 3 weeks is tight but doable for an MVP: single-region AWS module, docs, example app, and basic Terratest smoke tests. No HSM integration first pass.

Sana: I'll own examples + docs. Priya can own partner packaging + marketplace metadata. Tom/Ben take infra module and CI. Miguel will coordinate legal/marketing signoff.

Priya: Packaging checklist (quick draft):
- marketplace manifest (JSON) with correct product identifiers
- sample CloudFormation/Terraform wrapper for one-click deploy
- clearly call out license/EULA link and support contact
- footprint & cost estimate card

Sana: Docs checklist:
- README with quickstart and usage snippets
- architecture diagram (AMI mapping, VPC/subnet, KMS flow) — I'll sketch and upload to Figma
- example app (Node + React) that authenticates to the local private endpoint and shows a conversation
- upgrade path notes (how to pin model versions)

Ben: CI plan:
- GitHub Actions matrix: terraform fmt, `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against a sandbox account, smoke test that endpoint responds
- Terratest for infra validations (instance type, SG, kms key attachment)
- Matrix runs for arm64/x86 images (use different AMIs)
- Auto teardown on success/failure

Miguel: Security/legal:
- Need to confirm we can publish images bundled with model weights vs. pulling models at runtime. I'll ping Legal.
- Also export controls / regional availability note for EU/UK.

Priya: Ops notes for partner onboarding:
- Add a post-install webhook that calls partners' onboarding endpoint with instance metadata
- Provide an `onboarding.sh` script that runs behind the scenes (cloud-init) to register the instance to Redwood's private control plane (token-based)

Sana: Example of variables block we'll include in examples/terraform/variables.tf:
```
variable "region" {
  description = "AWS region to deploy into"
  type = string
  default = "us-east-1"
}
variable "instance_type_map" {
  description = "Map of arch -> instance type"
  type = map(string)
  default = { x86 = "c6i.large" arm = "c7g.large" }
}
variable "kms_key_arn" {
  description = "Optional KMS key for disk encryption"
  type = string
  default = ""
}
```

Tom: Add explicit outputs: redwood_endpoint, instance_ids, kube_node_pool (if using k8s), and `deployment_package_url` for marketplace artifact.

Ben: Testing note: use small instance sizes for CI, but smoke tests should run `curl -sS http://$ENDPOINT/health` and a short generation `POST /v1/generate` with a test prompt and assert 200 + non-empty body.

Miguel: Marketing/launch planning (post-beta): joint announcement checklist — product screenshots, verified pricing card, 1-page deploy guide for partners, customer success playbook. We'll sync Marketing after beta.

Priya: Items assigned / owners / DUE:
- infra module skeleton + Terratest setup -> Ben & Tom -> due in 10 days
- marketplace packaging + manifest -> Priya -> due in 12 days
- example app + README + arch diagram -> Sana -> due in 10 days
- Legal export/EULA check -> Miguel -> due in 5 days
- CI GH Actions + matrix -> Ben -> due in 12 days

Sana: I'll create the repo scaffold: `cloudco-marketplaceShim/` with folders: modules/infra, examples/, docs/, ci/. Will open PR and ping the channel. :rocket:

Ben: One more constraint: CloudCo requires the Terraform module to be MIT or Apache 2.0 compatible. Miguel — confirm the license we can ship the examples under.

Miguel: Noted. I'll confirm license and circle back.

marketplace-bot: New checklist created: `cloudco-shim-beta` — items: repo-scaffold, infra-module, example-app, terratest, packaging-manifest. Assigned to: Priya, Ben, Tom, Sana, Miguel.

Priya: Great — I'll schedule a 30m sync on Tuesday (calendar invite incoming). If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :calendar:

Tom: Quick Q — Should the module create a private S3 bucket for artifacts by default, or require partner to pass bucket ARN? Preferring opt-in create = true/false.

Sana: Opt-in create is better. Default false, but provide an AWS provider role that can be assumed if we create it for them.

Ben: I'll add that pattern to the module (create_bucket bool + bucket_kms_key).

Miguel: Awesome. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Legal and Marketing. Ping me if blockers show up. :thumbsup:

Priya: closing loop — leaving notes here so we have traceability for partner handoff.
